areas.title: HipHop Foundations
areas.existing_architecture: Existing pose-derived cycle/reference builder + phase-aligned angular tolerances, mirroring and audio timing/latency. Build only named-step reference/calibration candidates from authorized takes; preserve report-only identity measures and provisional reference flags. Generic all-style classifier or calibrated physical weight/contact claims are not implemented.
areas.next_operation: Human teaching demonstration and annotation → exact pinned extraction/DSP replay → reference/rule calibration candidate → heldout evaluation → real-device parity. No runtime promotion in this change.
areas.acceptance_gap: Physical teaching/rights/learner and device evidence open; no first-party capture supplied.
